verdict.rationale: Aider auto-commits every edit with a descriptive message and supports /undo and /git for reviewing/reverting diffs, plus built-in linting after edits and /test and /run commands to catch problems before merging (aider-docs-2,4,5,12,13,14). Missing for 10: a dedicated diff-viewing UI/command distinct from raw git, CI/PR-integration evidence, and independent hands-on validation that these checks reliably catch issues pre-merge.
